findings.title: Location filter is not tested for source-backed symbols from another compilation
findings.claim: The new tests only reference the defining assembly as a metadata image, where referenced symbols have no syntax at all. The branch of ReportIfLocatedInCompilation that matters for REQ-2283-F3 (a referenced symbol that has syntax in a tree outside the compilation, e.g. a CompilationReference as used for project-to-project references in the IDE) is not exercised. The code looks correct, but no test pins this down.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a variant that adds the defining compilation via compilation.ToMetadataReference() (CompilationReference) and asserts no AD0001 and no diagnostics located in the foreign tree.

findings.title: Global filter also drops Location.None diagnostics for types in the current compilation
findings.claim: The filter drops every diagnostic whose location is not in source, not only diagnostics about referenced types. At least one existing site (MsgPack018 CollidingMemberNamesInForceMapMode) computes a null location when the colliding member has no syntax, for example when it comes from a base class in metadata. Before this change that Error diagnostic was reported without a location; now it is silently dropped. I did not confirm by running that this path is reachable, so this is a risk and not a demonstrated regression.
findings.suggested_fix: Only drop diagnostics whose location is in source but in a foreign syntax tree, or fall back to the analyzed symbol's location instead of dropping; alternatively apply the filter only when formattedType is not from this compilation.

findings.title: Docs promise the defining project reports the diagnostics, which only holds if that project runs the MessagePack analyzer
findings.claim: README and MsgPack004.md state that problems in a referenced type are reported by the defining project. That only happens if the defining project itself references the MessagePack analyzer. Otherwise the consuming build now silently ignores, for example, unkeyed members of the referenced type.

evidence.quote: Diagnostics about the members of such a type are reported by the assembly that defines it rather than by the consuming project
This analyzer only reports on members declared in the project being compiled.

findings.suggested_fix: Qualify the sentence: 'reported when the defining project uses the MessagePack analyzer'.
